name: saltreach
description: Low Tide Works Saltreach: a server-authoritative village builder on tidal salt-flat islands.

scripts.build:server: esbuild src/server/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --external:pg-native --external:cloudflare:sockets --banner:js="import { createRequire as __saltreachRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __saltreachRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/server/main.mjs
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && npm run typecheck && npm run build:client && npm run build:server && cp src/client/index.html dist/public/index.html
